summary: Spark I Acquisition Corp (SPKL), a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement with ZincFive, Inc., a nickel-zinc battery solutions provider. The business combination involves SPKL domesticating from Cayman Islands to Delaware and merging through two merger subs. The transaction was unanimously approved by all relevant boards. No specific price per share, premium, or deal value is stated in the filing. The closing is expected in H2 2026, subject to SPKL shareholder approval and customary conditions. The SPAC will be renamed ZincFive upon close. Watch for shareholder vote and redemptions given SPAC mechanics.
